_legend.primitive: needs the compiler, type system, memory model, runtime, or execution tiers; core owns it
_legend.ecosystem-tool: build, package, devtools, live loop, test, receipt, diagnostics, editor: core owns it as a tool
_legend.shared-type: a data type two libraries must agree on: table, unit, receipt, tensor/array; core owns the type, libraries own the operations
_legend.library: a library author can build it with today's Jet; ships as an executable example at most
_legend.battery: library code, but a critical area needs it to reach a first program; a first-party package candidate
_legend.probe: which probe produces the evidence; judgment entries cite the archive instead

M-UNITS.why: dimensional analysis lives in types; two libraries must share one unit type

M-VALIDATION-RECEIPTS.why: jet-receipt-v2 is shipped; the question is library extensibility

M-DATA-TABLES.why: core.data is shipped; libraries need one table type to hand around

M-RASTER.why: image values over the shared tensor

M-FFT.why: buildable; the primitive question is SIMD and layout for the speed band
